1829-2228-4279.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
1829-2228-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Vindictive Vampire triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
1829-2228-4279.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

339-677-1115-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
339-677-1115-8227.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Loot by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

643-728-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
643-728-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Repeat from step 3.

579-2757-4385.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {2}, creating a creature token
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the creature token, untapping a basic land
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {2} due to Mana Reflection
Repeat

1170-1636-7526-7875.description:
Cast Twofold Intent using Party Thrasher's convoke ability by tapping creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Quill-Blade Laureate.
When Quill-Blade Laureate enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

2457-5794-6705-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

647-1563-2457-7810.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and is modified

1792-2539-3400-4762-7784.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting Devoted Druid.
Ivy triggers. Choose not to copy Retraction Helix
Resolve Retraction Helix
Cast Lion Umbra by paying {G}{G}, targeting Devoted Druid.
Ivy triggers, copying Lion Umbra twice due to Twinning Staff. Choose to have one copy target Ivy and the other copy target Devoted Druid.
Resolve all three Lion Umbras, attaching one to Ivy if it's modified and two to Devoted Druid.
Activate Devoted Druid using the ability given to it by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning the nontoken Lion Umbra from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time, then repeat step 8 one additional time.
Repeat from step 4.

1987-2556-4276-7487.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-2556-4276-7487.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mnemonic Wall and Zealous Lorecaster.
When Mnemonic Wall and Zealous Lorecaster enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2556-4276-7487.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

2793-3129-3743-5089-7178.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3129-3743-5089-7178.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Iron-Shield Elf by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

1409-1770-3671.description:
Activate Wily Goblin by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Wily Goblin enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Wily Goblin.
Resolve both Wily Goblin triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

3459-4474-5078-6918.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

1946-6747-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
1946-6747-7070.description:
Activate Nomads en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Nomads en-Kor.
The Nomads en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Nomads en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Sami.
Repeat.

104-3490-3641-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3490-3641-4050.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

2173-5220-6538-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Fear of Lost Teeth.
When Fear of Lost Teeth dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fear of Lost Teeth from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fear of Lost Teeth trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Cast Fear of Lost Teeth from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

431-4365-6441-6753.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-4365-6441-6753.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

1085-2921-4053.description:
Cast Chronozoa by paying {3}{U}. It will enter without a time counter on it due to Solemnity.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Chronozoa.
When Chronozoa dies, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself that also enter with no time counters on them due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 2 using a token copy of Chronozoa instead.

560-2034-2811-4593.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Elas il-Kor's first ability triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the creature tokens die, Elas il-Kor's second ability triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Repeat.
560-2034-2811-4593.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

1580-2921-4871-5334.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

1812-3525-3586.description:
Activate Magus Lucea Kane by tapping it, adding {2} and causing you to copy the next ability you activate or spell you cast that has {X} in its cost.
Activate Prismite by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Magus Lucea Kane.
Repeat.
Once you have a large number of delayed triggers, cast a spell or activate an ability with {X} in its cost to have Magus Lucea Kane copy that spell or ability infinitely.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3174-4050-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Switcheroo.
3174-4050-5434-5555.description:
Cast Switcheroo by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a face-down creature you control, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Repeat from step 2.

1336-5137-5963.notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
1336-5137-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Heronblade Elite's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Morphling's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1314-2757-3705-4050.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Squee, untapping a basic land.
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Brenard triggers, exiling Squee from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is a 1/1 Food Golem artifact creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Squee token, untapping a basic land.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Squee token, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

4067-4481-5806.notablePrerequisites:
Thieving Otter does not have summoning sickness.
Heavy Arbalest attached to Thieving Otter.
4067-4481-5806.description:
Activate Thieving Otter by tapping it, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Thieving Otter triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Thieving Otter.
Repeat.

305-1247-1656.notablePrerequisites: Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
305-1247-1656.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Llanowar Tribe's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

565-1283-2450-3604.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {3}, targeting Chromatic Orrery.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Chromatic Orrery.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead activate the Chromatic Orrery tokens using their second abilities, or target any other permanent.

631-4050-4424.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Grim Haruspex, adding {B}.
When Grim Haruspex dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Grim Haruspex from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Grim Haruspex's morph ability by paying {B}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

731-2385-3368-4703.notablePrerequisites:
Corrupted Conscience attached to Brallin.
You have at least seven cards in hand.
731-2385-3368-4703.description:
Cast Change of Fortune by paying {3}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate by paying {1}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Change of Fortune.
Resolve the copy of Change of Fortune, discarding your hand and drawing cards equal to the number of cards you've discarded this turn.
Brallin triggers for each card discarded, putting that many +1/+1 counters on itself and giving each opponent that many poison counters.
Resolve the original Change of Fortune, discarding your hand and drawing cards equal to the number of cards you've discarded this turn.
Brallin triggers for each card discarded, putting that many +1/+1 counters on itself and giving each opponent that many poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

891-3055-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Repeat.

1295-4400.notablePrerequisites:
Hermit Druid does not have summoning sickness.
You have no basic lands in library.
1295-4400.description:
Activate Hermit Druid by paying {G} and tapping it, reveal cards from the top of your library and then putting them into your graveyard.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, winning you the game.

1987-2493-3075-4714.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
1987-2493-3075-4714.description:
Activate Mana Geode by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Mana Geode and Archaeomancer, blinking them.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Mana Geode enters the battlefield, scry 1.
Repeat.
